summary: The proposed patch attempts to address the issue of drawing nominal scales similarly to categorical scales, but it lacks a comprehensive solution and additional testing.

issues.description: The patch only checks if the variable type is either 'categorical' or 'nominal', which may not cover all possible scenarios. Additional checks and handling for other variable types are needed.
The patch does not include new tests to verify the functionality of the changes. Without adequate testing, it is unclear whether the issue is fully resolved.
